areas.title: Efficient Multimodal FMs on Edge
areas.description: Adapting vision, language and multimodal FMs under edge compute, memory and communication constraints.

areas.title: Reliable & Decentralized ML
areas.description: Learning with limited labels, noisy or shifted data, and efficient FL/SL across heterogeneous devices.

areas.title: Privacy & Security on Edge
areas.description: Efficient secure aggregation and unlearning, with analysis of attacks and privacy–fairness trade-offs.

mapping_notes.enccluster: Foundation-model membership includes the related NeurIPS 2024 Federated Foundation Models workshop paper; the main project page distinguishes that version from the general FL study.
mapping_notes.fedser: Privacy refers to retaining raw speech on clients. The paper does not establish differential privacy or protection against update leakage.
mapping_notes.ae-psl: Parallel split learning belongs to decentralized learning and foundation-model adaptation; it is not federated averaging.
mapping_notes.mpsl: Multimodal parallel split learning belongs to decentralized learning and foundation-model adaptation; it is not federated averaging.
mapping_notes.decentralized: This area covers reliable learning and decentralized learning. PLiX and DA-MLDG concern few-shot or cross-domain learning, not distributed training. FL and parallel SL are distinct paradigms grouped here by their collaborative learning focus.
mapping_notes.foundation: Includes vision-only and multimodal adaptation. The description also reflects current language-model efficiency work; unpublished manuscripts do not enter public paper or project counts.
